annotations.title: Request a human sign-off (four-eyes review) before acting

description: Request that a named human reviews a consequential agent action against your criteria and returns approve / reject / escalate with reasons and an audit record. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 19 per decision (up to 15 minutes review); volume and response-time agreements on request.

basis.description: Data, reasons and context the action is based on.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

deadline.description: Optional: latest time for the decision.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

proposed_action.description: The action the agent wants to take.

name: request_human_signoff
